national_snap_coverage_county.csv.source: Census Reporter API (api.censusreporter.org), ACS 2024 5-year (a handful of large-county rows resolved from the 2024 1-year release), tables B22003 (households by SNAP receipt) and B17017 (households by poverty status)
national_snap_coverage_county.csv.method: coverage_ratio = SNAP households / households below 100% FPL; unserved_poor_hh = max(0, poor_hh - snap_hh). SCREENING INDEX ONLY: SNAP eligibility extends to ~130-200% FPL so coverage can exceed 1.0; this is not an eligibility model. College counties (student poverty) inflate the gap.
national_snap_coverage_county.csv.note: For a modeled gap (CA-style), see TODO-61: national PUMS LightGBM extension of ca-snap-gap.
